## **Meeting Oct 21, 2026 at 12:00 WAT**

Oct 21, 2026

MyCity ERP: Milestone 1 Handover and Sign-off

Invited: ifeoma@mycityapp.io, JBS Praxis, etudor@mycityapp.io, cynthia@mycityapp.io, elishaokoh897@gmail.com, tomblakeasaah@gmail.com, bode@mycityapp.io

System architecture and security configurations reviewed with UI enhancements and integration updates discussed.

## **Server infrastructure and deployment**

* Established separate staging and production environments to protect live data integrity.
* Configured servers with 8 cores, 18 GB RAM, and database m hosting on a 2-year subscription.
* Planned complete administrative and SSH server access handover to the client upon project completion.
* Restricted system monitoring access exclusively to the internal IT team and implementation consultants.

## **Security and access control**

* Configured multi-factor authentication for sensitive administrative roles to enhance overall system security.
* Implemented role-based access control to restrict module visibility and sensitive fields based on user designations.
* Tracked user actions, failed login attempts, and active sessions through a dedicated audit log.
* Set session timeouts to 120 minutes of inactivity and idle locks to 30 minutes.

## **Organization setup and data management**

* Configured organization profiles, custom logos, public holidays, and working schedules in the foundational module.
* Enabled bulk employee data importing using standardized Excel spreadsheet templates.
* Established customizable document and staff numbering formats with configurable prefixes and digits.
* Configured external API integrations including email servers, map services, and currency exchange rates.

## **UI and dashboard features**

* Edidiong Etudor requested alternative dark theme samples utilizing charcoal or dark gray backgrounds.
* Identified KPI tile alignment issues caused by multi-line text and agreed to refine visual harmony.
* Demonstrated the clock-in feature requiring registered device verification and location parameters.

## **AI integration roadmap**

* Planned the integration of Practice AI in milestone 10 for natural language operational queries.
* Utilized temporary API keys during development prior to deploying dedicated Google console keys.

## **Dashboard and partnership pipeline features**

* The milestone 2 delivery was pushed back by 2 days due to acceptance timing.
* JBS Praxis stated that organizational goals for the quarter derive from the performance module.

## **Attendance tracking and remote work location policies**

* Conference and client meeting locations require exact addresses to enable accurate parameter clock-ins.
* Remote workers must register their exact home coordinates to confirm location-compliant clock-ins.

## **Knowledge hub and company attendance policies**

* Policy updates follow a structured approval chain passing through the program manager before reaching the CEO.
* Employees must review and acknowledge updated company policies within 7 days.

## **Employee self-service and data management**

* JBS Praxis demonstrated the global audit log tracking all record changes.
* Employees can download complete profile data including sign-in history and leave balances once daily.
* The organizational chart automatically reflects personnel and line manager assignments from system data.

## **Security and authentication measures**

* Multi-factor authentication requires entering time-based one-time codes from authenticator applications.
* Users can register Windows pass keys to enable biometric sign-ins via fingerprint.

## **Staff community, announcements, and mailbox functionality**

* Staff community channels support voice note recording with automatic transcription features.
* Targeted announcements notify specific departments while general announcements reach all staff members.
* Platform emails use standardized signatures adjusting automatically between new messages and replies.

## **UI design feedback and platform integrations**

* Cynthia Osakunih flagged contrast issues and excessive green coloring within the dark mode interface.
* Cynthia Osakunih suggested redesigning birthday and work anniversary recognition cards for simpler visual appeal.
* JBS Praxis noted that personal API keys and backend vector embeddings support platform integrations.

![][image5]

![][image8]

![][image9]

Edidiong Etudor also noted a lack of visual harmony in key performance indicator tile heights, and JBS Praxis committed to building a demo to test these user interface adjustments before implementing changes ([00:50:26](#00:50:26)).
